proposals: The Lok Sabha Secretariat should publish a documented, open data service for parliamentary questions that includes full question and answer text in machine-readable form, so analysis like this does not rely on an undocumented API that exposes only subject lines and leaves answers in PDFs.

The Rajya Sabha Secretariat should add answer text in machine-readable form to its question data, since it already provides full question text but, like the Lok Sabha, publishes answers only as PDF documents.

The Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha Secretariats should adopt common party codes and ministry names across both Houses, so 'SHSUBT' and 'SS-UBT', or 'Road Transport & Highways' and 'Road Transport and Highways', do not need to be reconciled by hand before any cross-chamber total is possible.

Both Secretariats should attach a stable unique member identifier to every question in their published data, so questions can be matched to MPs and parties without name-spelling reconciliation, which left 138 Lok Sabha questions unattributed in this dataset.
